title: Hypothesis
description: A candidate explanation. The graph requires hypotheses to span classes, so that the agent cannot investigate three flavours of the same guess.

class.description: Same four classes the verdict commits to, and the same test decides between them. Unintended behaviour anywhere in the measurement path is `instrument_failure`, including a rule two models disagree about, because nobody chose the disagreement. `definition_change` requires the meaning of the metric to have changed, not merely its computation to be inconsistent. `upstream_data_defect` is a correct path over corrupted inputs. Classify by which of these a hypothesis asserts, because the verdict inherits the class of whichever hypothesis survives.

would_be_refuted_by.description: Stated BEFORE looking. A hypothesis whose author cannot say what would kill it is not a hypothesis, and the contract rejects it.
